claimant_statement: I am filing this claim for trip cancellation for my Barcelona booking. I had to cancel approximately one week before departure due to unexpected personal circumstances that arose in late February. I consulted my physician in early March regarding the situation, and my doctor advised that I should not travel at this time and that rest and reduced stress would be beneficial to my health during this period. Based on my physician's recommendation, I made the decision to cancel the trip. I have the airline and hotel cancellation confirmations showing the non-refundable charges. Total non-refundable costs are $4,200. I am requesting reimbursement under my trip cancellation coverage.
